name: Machine Learning in Biology
summary: How machine learning and deep learning are applied to sequences, structures, images and clinical data, including protein and genomic foundation models.

topics.name: Biological data as ML input: sequences, graphs, images and tabular omics
Supervised learning for genomics: predicting regulatory activity from DNA
Protein structure prediction and protein language models
Generative models for protein and molecule design
Bioimage analysis: segmentation and cell classification
Pitfalls: data leakage, batch effects, evaluation and interpretability
